verdict.rationale: Lovable documents a versioned public API (OpenAPI 3.1.0 spec, Try-it playground, date-pinned versions, deprecation policy) and an MCP server that lets agents create projects, send messages, inspect code and deploy apps. Nothing documents that the API matches everything the UI can do, and API keys require a Business or Enterprise plan. Missing for 10: an explicit API/UI parity statement, documented API coverage of UI features such as domains, collaboration, security scans, database editing and settings, and independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can do everything through the API that I can do in the UI

citations.quote: Lovable serves its full OpenAPI 3.1.0 document (info title "Lovable API") from the API host itself
your AI agent can create projects, send messages to Lovable, inspect code, deploy apps, and more, all without leaving the client you're already working in
The `/v1` surface is versioned and stable.
Executing requests needs a workspace API key, which requires a Business or Enterprise plan.
